area_intros.Setting up a ledger: Starting a ledger in a project, connecting it to your coding agent, and recording what the product already does.
area_intros.Recording what the product does: Recording each capability, and what changed in it and why, while the work happens.
area_intros.Reading the ledger: Checking what the ledger holds, and what the next edition will say, without printing anything.
area_intros.The documents it produces: The editions you hand to a client, and the documents your team reads.
